self_assessment: Fairly confident on behaviour, less so on exact strings: the new qutebrowser/misc/elf.py parses a real libQt5WebEngineCore.so.5 end-to-end (got QtWebEngine 5.15.19 / Chromium 87.0.4280.144) and survives hypothesis fuzzing with only ParseError escaping, and version.qtwebengine_versions() implements the ua -> elf -> pyqt -> unknown:<reason> chain feeding _backend()/_variant(); the full tests/unit suite shows no regressions vs the base commit (same ~90 pre-existing env failures), but the hidden tests may assert an exact WebEngineVersions.__str__ wording ('QtWebEngine X, based on Chromium Y (from src)') and a normalized version string ('5.14' rather than '5.14.0') that I had to reconstruct from the requirements rather than observe.
